newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share index jumps on foreign-led buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share index jumps on foreign-led buying.

text.p: The Jakarta share index rose 1.09 percent to 601.05 points on foreign-led buying of big and medium-sized stocks in late trade, brokers said on Friday.
Brokers said foreign buyers were engaged in follow-through buying from Thursday.
"The rise in Telkom and most other blue chip stocks, including cigarette stock Sampoerna, helped boost overall market sentiment," said one foreign broker.

Local investors were actively buying secondaries mostly on speculative interest, brokers said, adding that strong public interest in the initial public offer by Bank Negara Indonesia had helped to lift market sentiment since Monday.
